# Browser assets

Pinned local assets; no runtime CDN loading. Original licenses are stored beside each library.

| Asset | Version | Origin | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Cytoscape.js | 3.35.0 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/cytoscape@3.35.0/dist/cytoscape.min.js | MIT |
| MapLibre GL JS and CSS | 4.7.1 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/maplibre-gl@4.7.1/dist/ | BSD-3-Clause and bundled dependency notices |
| Roboto Latin regular/medium | @fontsource/roboto 5.2.9 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fontsource/roboto@5.2.9/files/ | OFL-1.1 |

NuGet supplies MatBlazor 2.10.0 static assets through `_content/MatBlazor`.
`asset-sha256.json` records the checked-in file hashes. Provider map styles/tiles are separately configured public browser resources.
